name: aside
description: /aside side chat for asking about the conversation without spending its context

liveFallback.title: Answer before the first turn ends
liveFallback.description: Until the session has finished its first turn there is no conversation to fork. On: the question is answered right away with a plain query over the conversation's text (uncached, marked 'live'). Off: it waits in a queue and is answered when the turn ends.

liveModel.title: Model for live answers
liveModel.description: Alias or id of the model for 'live' answers; the fork always uses the session's model.

maxHistory.title: Earlier questions that ride with each question
maxHistory.description: How many earlier exchanges of the side chat travel in each new question.
